title: Final Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the minimum energy of the harmonic oscillator as hbar omega / 2.

title: Use of Uncertainty Principle
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the uncertainty principle, Delta x Delta p = hbar / 2, in their reasoning.

title: Hamiltonian Formulation
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate understanding of the Hamiltonian for a harmonic oscillator and its components.

title: Average Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should show the calculation of average energy using the expressions for Delta x and Delta p.

title: Mathematical Inequality
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include the mathematical inequality used to derive the minimum energy condition.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in their calculations, particularly in the energy expressions.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout their calculations.
